description: Visual polish — CSS animations (shimmer, breathing, draw-in), styling upgrades (hero name size, event card height, 3D scratch hearts, bottom nav, closing bg, jhalar, shadows, RSVP stamp, hero heart, scroll indicator). All 14 items are primarily CSS changes with minor HTML attribute edits (hero heart SVG size, draw-in classes on SVG paths). No new JS modules needed. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: 1. In css/styles.css, before the '/* RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS */' section (~line 1670), add three new @keyframes blocks: (a) `shimmer` — `0%{background-position:-200% 0} 100%{background-position:200% 0}`, (b) `breathe` — `0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:0.8} 50%{transform:scale(1.03);opacity:1}` with 4s ease-in-out infinite, (c) `draw-in` — `0%{stroke-dashoffset:var(--path-len,100)} 100%{stroke-dashoffset:0}` with 1.2s ease-out.

2. Apply shimmer (item 6): Add `.has-shimmer { background-size: 200% 100%; animation: shimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite; }` utility class. Apply shimmer to `.i-divider__line` (make its background a shimmer-compatible gold gradient with background-size:200% 100%), `.section-label` (add shimmer with 5s delay), and gold heart SVGs via a shimmer overlay pseudo on `.i-hero__heart`, `.i-divider svg`. Keep delays staggered (2-8s) so shimmer doesn't fire everywhere at once. IMPORTANT: Be subtle — low contrast between start/end gradient stops.

3. Apply breathing (item 25): Add `animation: breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite` to `.i-card__mandala`. Add `animation: breathe 6s ease-in-out infinite` to `.i-divider svg` (very subtle scale pulse). Enhance `.diya-flame` by keeping existing flame-flicker and adding a subtle `breathe 5s ease-in-out infinite` as a secondary feel — or just leave flame-flicker which already pulses.

4. Apply draw-in to SVG ornaments (item 18): In css/styles.css add `.draw-in { stroke-dasharray: var(--path-len, 100); stroke-dashoffset: var(--path-len, 100); transition: stroke-dashoffset 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); }` and `.is-visible .draw-in { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }`. In index.html, add class `draw-in` and `style="--path-len:120"` (approximate path length) to the `<path>` elements inside `.i-card__corner` SVGs (4 corners) and `.i-divider` SVGs (the heart paths — skip these if they use fill, draw-in only works on stroked paths). For corner ornaments, the existing paths have `stroke` so draw-in will work.
5. Change .i-hero__name font-size (item 8): In css/styles.css, find `.i-hero__name` and change `font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 10vw, 4rem)` to `font-size: clamp(48px, 12vw, 64px)`.

6. Reduce hero heart SVG size (item 22): In index.html, find the `.i-hero__heart` div's SVG (currently `width="60" height="52"`) and change to `width="40" height="35"`. Keep the viewBox as-is (`0 0 60 52`).

7. Change scroll indicator to one-time animation (item 24): In css/styles.css, find `.i-hero__scroll` and change `animation: scroll-bounce 2s ease-in-out infinite` to `animation: scroll-bounce 2s ease-in-out 1; animation-delay: 3s; animation-fill-mode: both;`. This plays the bounce once after 3s, then holds.

8. Increase event card hero height (item 2): In css/styles.css, find `.i-event__hero`. Replace `aspect-ratio: 4 / 3` with `height: clamp(300px, 55vw, 420px)`. NOTE: The task spec says min(420px,55vw) but that gives only 206px at 375px viewport which is shorter than current ~250px. Using clamp(300px, 55vw, 420px) ensures minimum 300px on mobile. Also update `.i-event__hero-overlay` gradient to cover bottom 60%: change to `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(26,21,16,0.75) 0%, rgba(26,21,16,0.4) 40%, rgba(26,21,16,0.05) 60%, transparent 100%)`. Increase `.i-event__hero-text` bottom padding from 1.25rem to 1.5rem for breathing room.

9. Style scratch hearts as 3D embossed lockets (item 4): On `.i-scratch__heart`, add `filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.25))` (drop-shadow respects clip-path, unlike box-shadow). Add `.i-scratch__heart::before` pseudo: `content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 0%, transparent 55%); clip-path:` (same heart clip-path as canvas); `pointer-events:none; z-index:3;` — this creates the convex metallic sheen. Add `.i-scratch__heart::after` pseudo: `content:''; position:absolute; inset:4px; border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3); clip-path:` (same path scaled inward); `pointer-events:none; z-index:3; border-radius:0;` — simulates laurel wreath inner ring. CRITICAL: Both pseudos need `pointer-events:none` so scratching still works on the canvas.

10. Update bottom nav font size and RSVP pill (items 5, 14): Change `.bottom-nav__item` font-size from `0.6rem` to `clamp(11px, 2.5vw, 15px)`. Increase SVG icon size from 18px to 20px for proportion. Add `border-radius: 16px` to `.bottom-nav__item--accent`. Adjust `.bottom-nav__item` padding-top/bottom to `0.5rem` if text overflows.

11. Add couple photo as closing background (item 12): Add `.i-closing::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background: url('../assets/images/couple-640.webp') center/cover no-repeat; opacity:0.15; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; }`. The existing `.i-closing__content` has `z-index:2` so it stays above. The existing `.i-closing__diya` elements have `z-index:1` which also stays above.

12. Reduce jhalar height (item 16): Change `.jhalar` height from 22px to 8px. Change background-size from `22px 22px` to `12px 8px`. Change radial-gradient radius from `8px` to `3px` (e.g., `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, var(--jhalar-color, var(--i-bg)) 3px, transparent 3.5px)`). Add `opacity: 0.35` to `.jhalar`. Also update `.jhalar--flip` background-size similarly.

13. Deepen card shadows (item 17): Replace box-shadow on these selectors with `box-shadow: rgba(61,36,32,0.05) 0 1px 2px, rgba(61,36,32,0.15) 0 12px 24px -8px`: (a) `.i-card__inner` — currently `0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`, (b) `.i-event` — currently `0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)`, (c) `.i-family__card` — no box-shadow currently (add it), (d) `.i-venue__map` — no box-shadow currently (add it), (e) `.i-rsvp__card` — currently `0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` (update it).

14. Change RSVP stamp to square postage stamp (item 21): Change `.i-rsvp__stamp` from `border-radius:50%` to `border-radius:2px`. Change dimensions from 56×56 to 52×60 (portrait rectangle). Add `border: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.35)` and `outline: 2px solid var(--i-accent); outline-offset: 3px;` to create the perforated stamp look with an offset frame. Keep the existing background, font, and transform(-12deg).
acceptance_criteria: `node --check js/script.js` passes (no JS syntax errors — this FEAT doesn't add JS but verify it wasn't broken).
Hero names 'Mukul' and 'Sailly' render at the larger clamp(48px,12vw,64px) size.
Hero heart SVG is visibly smaller (40×35 vs previous 60×52).
Scroll indicator bounces once and stops (no infinite looping).
Event card images are taller (~300px+ on mobile) with more text breathing room.
Scratch hearts show embossed 3D metallic appearance with drop-shadow; scratching still reveals the text beneath.
Bottom nav labels are readable (11-15px range); RSVP button has rounded pill shape.
Closing section shows a faint couple photo behind the text.
Jhalar scalloped edges are thin (~8px) and subtle (low opacity).
Card elements (.i-card__inner, .i-event, .i-family__card, .i-venue__map, .i-rsvp__card) have deeper, layered shadows.
RSVP stamp looks like a square postage stamp with dashed/perforated border.
Gold elements (divider lines, section labels) have subtle traveling shimmer animation.
Decorative mandala SVGs have subtle breathing/pulse animation.
Corner ornament SVG paths draw themselves in when scrolled into view.
verification: Serve the site with `python3 -m http.server 8765` and visually confirm the 14 CSS changes. Use Playwright if available to screenshot and inspect the hero, events, scratch hearts, bottom nav, closing, and family sections.
findings: All 14 visual polish steps implemented. Shimmer animation applied to .i-divider__line and .section-label with staggered delays. Breathing added to .i-card__mandala. Draw-in applied to corner ornament SVG paths (8 paths total across 4 corners). Hero name font bumped to clamp(48px,12vw,64px). Hero heart SVG reduced to 40x35. Scroll indicator changed to single-play with 3s delay. Event card hero uses height:clamp(300px,55vw,420px) instead of aspect-ratio. Scratch hearts have drop-shadow and radial-gradient sheen pseudo-elements with pointer-events:none so scratching still works. Bottom nav font scaled to clamp(11px,2.5vw,15px), icons to 20px, RSVP pill has border-radius:16px. Closing section has faint couple photo ::before at 0.15 opacity. Jhalar reduced to 8px/0.35 opacity. All 5 card selectors have deeper layered shadows. RSVP stamp is now a square postage stamp with dashed border and outline-offset. No JS changes made. FEAT-002 note: the .draw-in class relies on .is-visible being added by the existing IntersectionObserver in script.js — ensure FEAT-002 does not remove or change the reveal/is-visible system.
